name: AEMULUS
recent: Aemulus 近期获得新加坡客户约 RM15.8 million 的数据中心与 AI 测试系统订单，并公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度及全年业绩。公司也出现独立非执行董事在公开市场增持股份的申报。
notable: 获得新加坡客户约 RM15.8 million 的数据中心与 AI 测试系统订单。
公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度及全年业绩。
独立非执行董事 Ch'ng Suat Ping 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日及 2 日在公开市场增持股份。

recent_en: Aemulus recently secured about RM15.8 million in data centre and AI test system orders from a Singapore customer and announced its quarterly and full-year results for the period ended 30 September 2026. The company also reported an independent non-executive director acquiring shares in the open market.
notable_en: Secured about RM15.8 million in data centre and AI test system orders from a Singapore customer.
Announced quarterly and full-year results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Independent non-executive director Ch'ng Suat Ping acquired shares in the open market on 1 and 2 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM27.216 million, up 21.7% QoQ and 42.8% YoY; net income was RM0.516 million with a net margin of 1.9%, turning positive from -3.1% in the prior quarter, while net income grew 2050.0% YoY.
